attr.title: Alex the Allegator 1
attr.desc: A very short Allegro-powered platform game for one or two players. Jump around the short level and try to find your dreamgirl Lola.
attr.desc_md: A very short platform game by Johan Peitz, made for the 1999 "Allegro Speedhack" jam. Jump around the level as Alex and try to find your dreamgirl Lola. Unfinished by the author's own admission, but playable start to finish.
